title: #10D protest outside Public Ministry and march demanding resignations and justice reforms
location: Outside central Public Ministry building, Barrio Gerona, zone 1, Guatemala City; reported march route toward PDH, Interior Ministry, Congress and Casa Presidencial; endpoint completion not confirmed by local report
organizer: Indigenous, campesino, student and civil-society groups; EFE names several organizations but not one overall organizer
participants_original: Hundreds of demonstrators, per EFE, at the initial protest outside MP
threshold_50_evidence: EFE explicitly reports hundreds of demonstrators in the protest at the Public Ministry; this is qualitatively above 50 at a named gathering.

start_date.summary: Both local Publinews and EFE date #10D action to Thursday 10 December 2020.

location.summary: The initial gathering was outside the main Public Ministry building in Barrio Gerona/zone 1, Guatemala City.

demands.summary: Demands included resignation of Attorney General Consuelo Porras, accountability and stopping investigation of Juan Francisco Sandoval; further resignations and constituent assembly are reported by EFE.

participants.summary: EFE reports hundreds at the gathering outside MP.

threshold_50.summary: Hundreds at a named gathering, above 50 qualitatively; this is the EFE original, not a second report independent of EFE.

notes: The EFE wire describes the wider demonstrations as ongoing for three weeks since 21 Nov; this 10 Dec gathering may be a later action within the same episode. Keep the month-specific action distinct for now and leave episode ownership unresolved pending adjacent-month review.
open_questions: Is the 10 Dec gathering a distinct protest within the same campaign or continuation of the 21 Nov episode under manual coding?
What was the actual end date of the wider demonstrations?
Any continued action after 10 Dec through 31 Dec and into January?

title: Health workers’ coordinated route blockades and demonstrations demanding overdue State productivity bonuses
location: Multiple route points across Guatemala, including Cito-Zarco and Colomba in Quetzaltenango; Pajapita, San Marcos; Palín, Escuintla; Puerto Barrios, Izabal; El Tejar, Chimaltenango; San Antonio, Jutiapa; San Luis, Petén; Mazatenango, Suchitepéquez; Retalhuleu; separate Hospital Regional de Occidente protest, Quetzaltenango.
organizer: Health workers / union group; article attributes demands to workers but does not identify a single organizer in the read scope
participants_original: Hundreds across several separate demonstrations, per Prensa Libre; per-site counts are not given
threshold_50_evidence: No evidence that any individual listed gathering exceeded 50; hundreds is an aggregate across distinct locations and cannot be pooled.

start_date.summary: Article explicitly dates route blockades and demonstrations to Tuesday 29 December 2020.

location.summary: Several route locations and a Quetzaltenango hospital protest are listed separately.

demands.summary: Workers demanded Q3,000 in State productivity bonus arrears and job stability.

participants.summary: Hundreds reported across distinct demonstrations; none of the named sites receives its own count.

notes: Nationally coordinated multiple-site action may be one nationally organized episode, but threshold evidence is aggregate only; no attendees may be combined across sites for a single-gathering threshold. Article mentions preceding 28 Dec action at Finance Ministry; ownership/continuity unresolved.
open_questions: Was any single gathering among sites 50+?
Did the separate Hospital Regional de Occidente protest meet threshold?
Was the 28 Dec Finance Ministry action part of this same episode?
Was the government’s reported payment the demanded bonus or a separate payment?

title: Third consecutive Saturday protest at Plaza de la Constitución and additional departmental gatherings (#5D)
location: Plaza de la Constitución, Guatemala City; separate gatherings reported in Quetzaltenango, Salamá, Cobán, Retalhuleu, Poptún, Petén and Santa Cruz del Quiché (no counts per additional site)
scope: local with other sites reported separately
organizer: University, indigenous/campesino labor groups, women’s groups and citizens; no single organizer established
participants_original: Thousands reported across Plaza and several departments collectively; Plaza described as the largest gathering, with a lower crowd than prior Saturdays, but no site-specific count.
threshold_50_evidence: Source does not give a count for Plaza alone; qualitative report indicates Plaza was the largest site, but >=50 there remains pending without site-specific magnitude.

start_date.summary: Body/byline dates the gathering to 5 December 2020.

location.summary: Largest gathering was at Plaza de la Constitución; other departments/cities separately reported.

demands.summary: Protesters rejected government/Congress conduct, called for constituent assembly and wider system changes.

participants.summary: The article reports thousands at Plaza and in some departments collectively; Plaza was largest but without a distinct numerical count.

threshold_50.summary: No site-specific attendance count for Plaza; retain threshold as pending.

notes: Local report calls this the third consecutive Saturday and explicitly links its context to preceding 21 and 28 Nov protest days. Preserve as a dated candidate and flag episode/onset ownership for reviewer; do not automatically merge all rallies.
open_questions: Are the 21 Nov, 28 Nov and 5 Dec Saturday rallies distinct episodes within an ongoing wave or one continuous episode under codebook rules?
What was the ending date of the wider wave?
Do named extra sites meet threshold individually?
What was the Plaza-only participant magnitude?
protester_violence_note: Article calls the Dec 5 main Plaza gathering peaceful but mentions paint thrown at nearby businesses and municipal structure damage without attributing it to the crowd; November violence must not transfer.

title: Fourth consecutive Saturday Plaza protest with artistic performances (#12D)
location: Plaza de la Constitución, Guatemala City
organizer: Students from USAC and Rafael Landívar and civic organizations; no single organizer identified
participants_original: Groups of protesters; no numeric or qualitative magnitude estimate given.
threshold_50_evidence: No attendance number; threshold remains pending.

demands.summary: Reject government actions and corruption; some called for President's resignation.

notes: Source calls it fourth consecutive Saturday and links the movement's trigger to 21 Nov. Do not merge automatically without reviewer episode decision.
open_questions: Did this specific gathering exceed 50 simultaneously?
How do 21 Nov, 28 Nov, 5 Dec and 12 Dec map to same/different episodes under onset/end rules?
Were there additional Saturday actions on 19 or 26 Dec?

title: Health workers demonstrate outside Finance Ministry over Q3,000 bonus payment (#28D)
location: Outside Ministry of Public Finance, Guatemala City; no more precise address in read scope.
organizer: Public health workers; union representative from Hospital General San Juan de Dios quoted, broader organizer unidentified.

location.summary: Demonstration outside the Ministry of Public Finance (Minfin) in Guatemala City.

demands.summary: Workers demanded overdue Q3,000 bonus; article quotes Health Ministry's payment-status response.

notes: Do not infer threshold from the later 29 Dec multi-site report. This is one specific dated site; continuity with 29 Dec separate blockades remains unresolved.
open_questions: Did the Minfin gathering exceed 50 at once?
Was the Dec 29 route action a continuation of this protest or separate gatherings?
Was the payment Health describes the same Q3,000 bonus workers demanded?
